independent_methods.description: Wrote a standalone Python script (outside the repository, in /tmp, not committed) that does not import or call any lingxi/internal code. findings.title: Owner-authored 'independent_redteam' self-attestation is not itself independently verifiable evidence, and drifts from the master plan
findings.detail: p0_swap_data_fitness.json contains an 'independent_redteam' block (reviewer: 'Sonnet 5 Thinking High', verdict: PASS_DATA_FITNESS_CLASSIFICATION) and p0_swap_data_fitness.md section 8 narrates a prior Sonnet review, but both are prose written by the same owner-side agent that authored the rest of the artifact, inside a file only the owner controls. No separate reviewer-authored, hash-bound receipt existed for this claim before the present file. Separately, FIRST_BATTLE_MASTER_PLAN.md section 5.11 heading still reads '(待独立红队)' (pending independent red-team), which is inconsistent with the artifact's own REDTEAM_PASS_DATA_FITNESS_CLASSIFICATION_STOPPED status and the embedded independent_redteam.verdict. This is the exact 'owner self-declares PASS' pattern this review was commissioned to resolve.
findings.resolution: This receipt is the first artifact in this lineage authored by a separate reviewer identity, with its own independently executed commands and its own self-excluding hash, and it supersedes the evidentiary weight of the owner-authored independent_redteam block for the current generation. Governance should update FIRST_BATTLE_MASTER_PLAN.md section 5.11 to point at this receipt instead of, or in addition to, the owner's self-narrated redteam text; this reviewer did not make that edit because plan updates are reserved for the governance owner.
